summary.name: IntelliDock
summary.one_liner: IntelliDock is a macOS utility that automatically hides the Dock when a window overlaps it.
use_cases: Hide the Dock when a window covers it
Keep the Dock out of the way on a small screen
Install a macOS Dock auto-hide tool via Homebrew
Pair with a window manager like Grid
summary.what_it_does: IntelliDock hides the macOS Dock when it is overlapped by a window and shows it again as needed. The user can adjust the distance at which the Dock begins to hide. It can be downloaded directly or installed for Homebrew users with a brew command. The page says it needs system API access to hide and show the Dock, which is why it is not on the Mac App Store. The author states the app collects no user data. The page recommends Grid as a companion window manager.
notable: Hides the Dock only when a window overlaps it
Adjustable distance for when the Dock starts hiding
Not on the Mac App Store because it uses system APIs to control the Dock
caveats: Not available on the Mac App Store
Recommends Grid for best compatibility with window managers
